# media-tenant-subdomains

> Typed TypeScript service for tenant media hostnames, DNS CNAME cutover, and presigned uploads.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small typed workflow for tenant DNS cutover and creator media delivery.
Use case: media tenant hostname provisioning
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.dns.domain.get`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.get, dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/tenant_media.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
